# aioice

`aioice` is an implementation of Interactive Connectivity Establishment (RFC 5245) built on Python's `asyncio` framework.

This local package is based on upstream [`aiortc/aioice`](https://github.com/aiortc/aioice) tag [`0.10.2`](https://github.com/aiortc/aioice/tree/0.10.2). The local patch is documented in [PATCHES.md](PATCHES.md).
